# GitHub Copilot repository instructions

Read `AGENTS.md`, the project plan, relevant ADR/contracts and the previous phase summary before making changes.

Prefer bounded backend, test and CI tasks defined in a GitHub issue. Respect allowed/forbidden paths. Do not invent API contracts or change shared architecture silently. Add regression tests for bugs and write the required task handoff before completion.

Never commit credentials, provider tokens, signed URLs or real student data.
